rows.reasoning: Assembly Member Gipson voted Aye on SB 32 (2015-2016), a single-subject bill whose operative section requires the state board to ensure statewide greenhouse gas emissions are reduced to at least 40 percent below the 1990 limit by a firm deadline, December 31, 2030, matching the rung text "Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines."
